mapper.select: SELECT n.user_id, n.article_id, a.title, au.name AS author_name, n.created_at, n.note_text FROM article_note n JOIN zh_article a ON a.article_id = n.article_id JOIN zh_author au ON au.author_id = a.author_id WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article_note (user_id, article_id, note_text) VALUES (#{userId}, #{articleId}, #{noteText})
mapper.select: SELECT article_id, title, author_name FROM v_my_unread
SELECT task_id, keyword, executed_at, duration_ms, result_cnt FROM search_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND result_cnt = 0 ORDER BY executed_at DESC LIMIT 50
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_follow (user_id, author_id, follow_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{authorId}, now())
mapper.update: UPDATE user_follow SET unfollow_at = now() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND author_id = #{authorId} AND unfollow_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM user_follow WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND author_id = #{authorId} AND unfollow_at IS NULL
